text:
maria: Heads-up — seeing a steady drop in kv_residency_percent for sessions that go past ~20k tokens. Hit rate stays mostly flat but evictions spike and memory growth looks nonlinear. Dashboards are noisy so hard to tell whether this is fragmentation or eviction churn.
joel: I noticed something similar on canary yesterday. Eviction counters are high but we don't break them down by age or reason, so tail churn is hidden.
sam: Can you paste the spike window and any PromQL you used?
maria: Quick slice from last night (UTC): 02:13–02:32. PromQLs I ran: 
```
sum(increase(kv_evictions_total[5m])) by (age_bucket)
avg_over_time(kv_residency_percent[10m])
(1 - sum(kv_cache_hits) / sum(kv_cache_lookups)) as hit_rate // quick calc
```
joel: That first query assumes age_bucket exists — it doesn't yet. We're aggregating by shard only.
alison: Proposal: add age_bucket label on eviction counter with buckets: "0-1m", "1-5m", "5-20m", "20m+" and add an eviction_reason label (thrash|mem_pressure|manual). That would let us see whether old fragments are being evicted or recent inserts.
sam: Also suggest capturing "residency_streak" histogram per slot so we can compute p50/p95/p99 residency durations. Right now we only have a point-in-time residency gauge which hides streak behavior.
maria: quick log snapshot from the window (sanitized):
```
kv_evictions_total{shard="s2"} 482
kv_evictions_by_age{age_bucket="1-5m"} 310
kv_residency_percent 0.58
kv_hit_rate 0.86
kv_memory_bytes 1234567890
```
maria: Based on that, most evictions were mid-aged, which makes me suspect fragmentation and page-chain churn during long contexts.
joel: Can we add a small synthetic replay test? Replay long sessions with repeating keys to measure eviction amplification (evictions per unique key touched).
sam: Test plan: 1) run 1k long sessions (30k tokens) with deterministic key reuse, 2) measure increase(kv_evictions_total[5m]) and compute evictions / unique_keys. If evictions / unique_keys >> 1 then we have amplification.
kv-bot: Snapshot uploaded to s3: s3://infra-artifacts/kv-debug/2732104567-snapshot.json :thumbsup: 
maria: Dashboard asks: 
- Stacked area: evictions by age_bucket (5m resolution)
- Heatmap: residency percent over time by slot shard
- Line: kv_hit_rate vs tail_latency_99 (correlation)
- Counter: eviction_reason breakdown
Alert idea: when sum(increase(kv_evictions_total[5m])) > 500 && avg_over_time(kv_residency_percent[10m]) < 0.6 for 15m -> page a runtime oncall.
alison: I'll spin up a Grafana draft in the eng-runtime folder and add the age_bucket labeling to the ingestion pipeline PR. Will also add a lightweight eval that runs the synthetic replay overnight.
joel: One more thought — add a tracepoint at kernel selection where we compute prefix_kv_miss. Correlate prefix misses with eviction spikes; might show kernel heuristics evicting hot prefixes unexpectedly.
maria: Perfect. If you add the PR link here I'll review. Thanks all.
